title: 第926章 新盟主厉间执法长老柳厉图谋不轨第925章 审判
slug: 御兽开局炼妖壶吞噬就变强
lines: 推荐各位书友阅读：御兽：开局炼妖壶，吞噬就变强第一卷：默认第926章新盟主厉间，执法长老柳厉，图谋不轨（..la）“盟主客气，晚辈能有所成就，离不开联盟栽培。”
现任盟主厉间摇了摇头，面容愈加慈祥：
“此言差矣，联盟说到底只是给你提供一个平台，能否靠着这个平台一跃登天，终究还是要看自己的努力与本事。”
“老夫平生见过的年轻俊杰不少，但像五圣子这般，失踪十余年归来便已踏入八阶，却是头一回见，当真是惊才绝艳。”
夜玄没有接话，只是拱手道：“盟主谬赞了。”
两人间又寒暄几句，气氛逐渐融合。
殿中那些八阶长老见盟主对夜玄态度和善。
心中顿时五味杂陈。
有的人直呼联盟即将多出一员大将，未来可期。
而有的人，则在心中叹气，望向夜玄目光带上一抹怜悯神情…
忽然，一道不和谐的声音从人群中响起，打断二者交谈。
便见一名红袍老者从侧列走出，这老者身材瘦削，一只眼睛戴有黑色眼罩，徒增几分冷意。
他皮笑肉不笑，腰间挂有一枚暗红色令牌，上面刻着“审判教司”
四个大字。
“五圣子，老夫乃联盟审判教司执法长老，姓柳，单名一个厉字，负责联盟执法审判。”
红袍老者拱了拱手：
“敢问五圣子，你消失十余年，归来时，便从六阶一跃成为八阶御兽师，不知这其中的缘由，可否为我等解惑？”
他话音落下，殿中气氛顿时安静几分。
不少目光落在夜玄身上，带着探究和审视，显然这也是众长老心中疑惑。
夜玄面上笑意不变，心中却暗暗冷笑。
来者不善，善者不来。
他放下手中茶杯，目光不闪不避迎向柳厉：
“柳长老说笑了，修炼之事，本就是各有机缘，我不过是运气好，得到一些机遇，侥幸突破八阶御兽师境界。”
“侥幸？”
柳厉笑容加深几分，“六阶到八阶，可不是一句侥幸就能解释的。”
“五圣子若是有什么奇遇，不妨说出来与我等分享，也好让联盟其他年轻子弟沾沾光，共同成长，为联盟建设添砖加瓦。”
夜玄闻言，面色不变：“柳长老此言差矣，若奇遇能复制，那还叫奇遇么？这就好比问一条鱼，为何能在水里游得那么快，难不成还要它把水里的秘密公之于众？”
殿中有人忍不住轻笑一声，又连忙憋回。
柳厉面色微僵，显然没想到夜玄会用这种不软不硬的方式回击。
他正要再开口，主位上的厉间盟主适时出声，笑着摆了摆手：
“好了好了，柳长老也是关心联盟年轻一辈的成长，夜圣子既然不愿多说，想必自有其考量，今日是欢迎夜圣子回归的好日子，不必在这些细枝末节上纠缠。”
柳厉闻言，抱拳朝盟主厉间行了一礼，他没有退下，声音骤然拔高几分：
“那这个问题就此跳过。”
content_en:
Recommended reading for all book friends: Taming the Beast: The Demon Refining Pot at the Beginning, Devouring It to Make You Stronger Volume 1: Default Chapter 926 The new alliance leader Li Jian, the law enforcement elder Liu Li, has evil intentions (..la) "The alliance leader is polite, the younger generation can achieve something, and it is inseparable from the cultivation of the alliance."
The current alliance leader Li Jian shook his head, his face becoming more kind:
"This is wrong. In the final analysis, the alliance only provides you with a platform. Whether you can rely on this platform to reach the sky depends on your own efforts and abilities."
"I have seen many young heroes in my life, but like the Fifth Saint Son, who has already entered the eighth level after missing for more than ten years, this is the first time I see him. I am truly astonished and talented."
Ye Xuan didn't answer, but just cupped his hands and said, "The alliance leader is so complimentary."
The two exchanged a few more pleasantries, and the atmosphere gradually merged.
The eighth-level elders in the palace saw that the leader was kind to Ye Xuan.
My heart suddenly felt mixed.
Some people say that the alliance is about to have one more general, and the future is promising.
Some people sighed in their hearts and looked at Ye Xuan with a look of pity...
Suddenly, a discordant voice sounded from the crowd, interrupting the conversation between the two.
Then I saw an old man in red robe walking out from the side row. This old man was thin and had a black eyepatch on one eye, which only added to his coldness.
He is smiling but not smiling, and there is a dark red token hanging on his waist with "Judgement Priest" engraved on it.
Four big characters.
"Fifth Holy Son, I am the law enforcement elder of the Alliance's Judgment Division. My surname is Liu, and my only name is Li. I am responsible for the Alliance's law enforcement and trials."
The old man in red robe cupped his hands:
"I would like to ask the Fifth Holy Son, you disappeared for more than ten years, and when you came back, you jumped from the sixth level to the eighth level beast master. I don't know the reason for this. Can you help us clear up my doubts?"
After his words fell, the atmosphere in the palace suddenly became quieter.
Many eyes fell on Ye Xuan, with inquiry and scrutiny. Obviously, this was also the doubt in the minds of the elders.
The smile on Ye Xuan's face remained unchanged, but he sneered secretly in his heart.
Those who come are not good, and those who are good will not come.
He put down the tea cup in his hand and looked at Liu Li without blinking:
"Elder Liu was joking. Cultivation matters are all given by chance. I was just lucky and got some opportunities and luckily broke through to the eighth-level beast master realm."
"A fluke?"
Liu Li's smile deepened a bit, "The sixth level to the eighth level is not something that can be explained by luck."
"If the Five Saints have any adventures, you might as well tell them and share them with us, so that other young people in the alliance can benefit from it, grow together, and contribute to the construction of the alliance."
When Ye Xuan heard this, his expression did not change: "Elder Liu's words are wrong. If an adventure can be replicated, is it still an adventure? It's like asking a fish why it can swim so fast in the water. Is it possible that it should reveal the secrets in the water to the public?"
Someone in the hall couldn't help but chuckle, and quickly suppressed it.
Liu Li's face was slightly stiff, obviously he didn't expect Ye Xuan to fight back in such a neither soft nor hard way.
Just as he was about to speak again, Leader Li Jian spoke up at the right time, smiled and waved his hand:
"Okay, okay, Elder Liu is also concerned about the growth of the younger generation of the alliance. Since Saint Ye doesn't want to say more, he must have his own considerations. Today is a good day to welcome Saint Ye back, so there is no need to get entangled in these minutiae."
Hearing this, Liu Li cupped his fists and saluted the alliance leader Li Jian. He did not retreat, and his voice suddenly rose a bit:
"Then skip this question."
title_en: Chapter 926 New Alliance Leader Li Jian and Law Enforcement Elder Liu Li have evil intentions Chapter 925 Trial
